mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of guidelines for writing in psychology and related disciplines."
The APA style is a set of guidelines for writing in psychology and related disciplines.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term that is used to describe a system philosophical argument that involves some kind of contradictory process between opposing sides."
Dialectics as a philosophical method is a term that is used to describe a system philosophical argument that involves some kind of contradictory process between opposing sides.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an act, that if successful, produces understanding."
Interpretation is an act, that if successful, produces understanding.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the hallmark of concision, its most distinctive characteristic."
Brevity is the hallmark of concision, its most distinctive characteristic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the detailed description of resources from which information or ideas were obtained in preparing the essay."
Reference References are the detailed description of resources from which information or ideas were obtained in preparing the essay.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the particular dialectical method of argument employed by the 19th Century German philosopher, G.W.F."
Hegelian dialectics refers to the particular dialectical method of argument employed by the 19th Century German philosopher, G.W.F.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which is loved by the gods."
Euthyphro replies that the pious is that which is loved by the gods.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication that the researcher is not the first person to engage in that project or subject matter, and that he or she is using other people's ideas to build a new one."

Referencing a research work is an indication that the researcher is not the first person to engage in that project or subject matter, and that he or she is using other people's ideas to build a new one.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are described using language that affirms their worth and dignity."
People are described using language that affirms their worth and dignity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that an expression - whether a statement or a set of statements - is concise."
Concision means that an expression - whether a statement or a set of statements - is concise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement that makes some clear, definite assertions about the subject under discussion."
A thesis is a statement that makes some clear, definite assertions about the subject under discussion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means conveying a considerably large set of information in a brief space."
Being concise means conveying a considerably large set of information in a brief space.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered the first person to have carried out a history of academic footnoting as used in history."
Anthony Grafton is considered the first person to have carried out a history of academic footnoting as used in history.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a new and unique production of work; it is not merely a specular reproduction of what is being interpreted."
Interpretation itself is a new and unique production of work; it is not merely a specular reproduction of what is being interpreted.
fib: ______ refers to thoroughness in carrying out the research in such a way that no stone is left unturned, and every logical thread is followed.
Rigour
Rigour refers to thoroughness in carrying out the research in such a way that no stone is left unturned, and every logical thread is followed.
______ is a list of the full details of all the sources you cited in your paper.
Bibliography
A Bibliography is a list of the full details of all the sources you cited in your paper.
______ means that the work should be as short as necessary (though, of course, not shorter than necessary).
Brevity (to be brief)
Brevity
Brevity (to be brief) means that the work should be as short as necessary (though, of course, not shorter than necessary).

Primary materials
Primary materials refer to the original writings of the philosopher, while secondary materials refer to reactions by other philosophers in terms of interpretations, reviews and criticisms.
______ is an academic research that is undertaken by a student in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the award of a First Degree.
Long Essay or Project
A Long Essay or Project is an academic research that is undertaken by a student in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the award of a First Degree.

Dialectics is a development, so to speak, that proceeds in spirals, not in a straight line; a development by leaps, catastrophes, and revolutions; 'breaks in continuity'.

Orderliness means that a work is arranged in such a way that every piece is placed where it properly belongs and one point follows another in an organised manner.

publisher
The publisher is the entity primarily responsible for producing the work or making it available to the public.

Marxian dialectics is a form of Hegelian dialectics which applies to the study of historical materialism.

Quotation marks
Quotation marks are used around article and chapter titles.

Coherence

Coherence is the feature of philosophical research and writing by which a body of statements has internal concord or agreement, such that it makes a central point in a strong and mutually-reinforcing manner.
